task.name: Install_camp_sign
task.when: During Build after the public frontage is approved

step.action: Confirm the sign drawing, letter order, support, anchor, and lighting plan in 📦 Build_Book.
Assemble and anchor the sign support in its mapped position.
Attach each sign letter in the printed order.
Have the Power Lead install and test the sign lighting.
Have the Build Lead inspect every connection, support, and anchor.

passWhen.criterion: The sign matches the current drawing and letter order.
Every support, connection, and anchor is installed.
The lighting operates and its cable route is protected.
No pedestrian or service route is blocked.
